title: Things to improve in order to stay
body:
I think I've tried every productivity and organization app, and this is definitely the most intuitive and useful. Great UI. 
However, in order for the price - quality relation to be worth it, I think they should focus on the motivational side more. Meaning that the stats part for example, is extremely limited. I would like to see all my habits together in a large table to see how well I am doing and compare the process. Not just today and the strike. The visual picture of your habits laid out like that will give more motivation to the user to continue. To have a bigger picture in mind. 
Plus, there should be a way to download your statistics and get more interesting insides.
Moreover, it would be nice to create routines with several habits inside. And you could also make a toggle to show the habits inside and their level of completion on that large table I mentioned. 
Thank you

body:

The free app only lets us save one or two events, after that it tells us we have to download the paid version. 
If we can’t experiment the free app to see if it suits our purposes how are we going to buy it?
Can you help us please?
